name: jev-gate
description: Jev Gate in one plugin: the orchestration gate, the extractive compactor, the Vitest log folder, the Jev effort and model router and the jev_evidence tool. Every part is on by default; each has its own on/off option.

gateMode.title: Gate: mode (auto, native, off)
gateMode.description: auto: Jev decides whether a request is split across workers. native: route only the calls you make. off: the gate does nothing. A JEV_GATE_MODE variable overrides this.

compactEnabled.title: Compact: Enable extractive compaction
compactEnabled.description: Off registers no hook at all. Every compaction is the engine's own.

compactMode.title: Compact: Mode
compactMode.description: shadow: build and log the digest, let the engine compact. active: compact with the digest; the engine's summarizer is not asked.

compactBudgetChars.title: Compact: Budget (characters)
compactBudgetChars.description: Characters for the digest and the kept recent messages together, 8000 to 400000.

compactSubagents.title: Compact: Subagents too
compactSubagents.description: Also answer a subagent's own auto compactions.

compactManual.title: Compact: Also /compact
compactManual.description: Also answer /compact typed without instructions. Off leaves /compact the engine's.

outputEnabled.title: Output: Enable output folding
outputEnabled.description: Off registers no hook at all. Every Bash result is the host's own.

routerEnabled.title: Router: Enable the Router
routerEnabled.description: Off registers no hook at all. Every request keeps its native model and effort.

routeSubagentModel.title: Router: Route subagent models
routeSubagentModel.description: Choose the model of a subagent: an inheriting built-in (general-purpose, claude, Plan, Explore) that names none, or any Agent call that names one.

routeExplicitSpawnModel.title: Router: Route named subagent models
routeExplicitSpawnModel.description: Also choose the model when the Agent call names one (model: "opus"): the name is treated as a default.

routeSubagentEffort.title: Router: Route subagent effort
routeSubagentEffort.description: Set each subagent's reasoning effort from its task, on every request its loop makes.

routeMainEffort.title: Router: Route main-thread effort
routeMainEffort.description: Choose the effort of the main thread's requests, per turn.

routeMainModel.title: Router: Route main-thread model
routeMainModel.description: Choose the model of the main thread's requests, per turn. Enabled by default.

typesafeApiKey.title: Jev API key (all features)
typesafeApiKey.description: One key for Gate, Lean, Router and Evidence, shared with Codex. Blank opens the local key-entry screen when no environment or saved key is available.

routerFastModel.title: Router: Fast profile model
routerFastModel.description: Alias or exact model ID for the fast profile.

routerStandardModel.title: Router: Standard profile model
routerStandardModel.description: Alias or exact model ID for the standard profile.

routerDeepModel.title: Router: Deep profile model
routerDeepModel.description: Alias or exact model ID for the deep profile.

routerFrontierModel.title: Router: Frontier profile model
routerFrontierModel.description: Exact model ID for the frontier profile. Blank leaves the profile unconfigured.

routerMinUpgradeConfidence.title: Router: Upgrade confidence floor
routerMinUpgradeConfidence.description: Least probability, 0.5 to 1, that the work needs at least the stronger model or higher effort: Jev's answer mass at or above it.

routerMinDowngradeConfidence.title: Router: Downgrade confidence floor
routerMinDowngradeConfidence.description: Least probability, 0.5 to 1, that the weaker model or lower effort is enough: Jev's answer mass at or below it.

routerTimeoutMs.title: Router: Preparation budget (ms)
routerTimeoutMs.description: Total routing preparation budget, including host reads and Jev, 50 to 30000 ms. Past it the request runs natively.

routerLogDecisions.title: Router: Log decisions
routerLogDecisions.description: Write one metadata-only line per decision to the debug log. Never task text or the key.

routerAllowFable.title: Router: Router: Allow automatic Fable selection
routerAllowFable.description: Opt in to new automatic Fable model targets, including owned planners and workers. A manually selected root remains usable when off.
